name: znacht
description: Znacht – Wochenplaner für Abendessen (Testversion). Befehle für Emulatoren, Daten und Tests.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix functions ci && npm --prefix scripts ci && cd app && flutter pub get
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-znacht --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit=./emulator-data
scripts.emulators:fresh: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-znacht
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix scripts test && cd app && flutter test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-znacht-rules "npm --prefix functions run test:rules"
